description: Get one scrape's live status (queued, running, done, error), progress (stage, percent, searches done, places found/extracted), resultCount, credits reserved/charged, and coverage (how many delivered rows have an email, phone, website, socials...). Use it to check on a scrape without waiting; use wait_for_scrape to block until it finishes.

includeSearches.description: Also return the individual Google Maps searches (query, URL, result count). Can be long.

scrapeId.description: The scrape id returned by start_scrape or list_scrapes (a UUID).

name: get_scrape
title: Get scrape status
